versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Os_11014 If the ProtectionHook returns PRO_TERMINATETASKISR and no Task or ISR can be associated with the error, the running OS-Application is forcibly terminated by the Operating System module. If even no OS-Application can be assigned, ShutdownOS is called.
